stem: Baby in the country, firm, red, tender lump in groin, not eating/drinking as much as normal, vomiting, some bowel changes. There is no paediatric surgeon in the town but he is coming tomorrow for a clinic. You have got IV access. What would you like to do next:

options.text: Give analgesia, make an appointment for paeds clinic tomorrow
Give analgesia, refer to adult surgeons in the town
Give analgesia and transfer to a paediatric surgery facility
